An '''Imperial communications hub''' was located on [[Sunfall Peak]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was [[Mission to Sunfall Peak|raided]] by Rebels in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
